arguments:
{"script":"mkdir -p group_inspect_workspace
cp /etc/group group_inspect_workspace/group_raw.txt
sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//' -e '/^$/d' group_inspect_workspace/group_raw.txt > group_inspect_workspace/group_sanitized.txt
cut -d: -f1 group_inspect_workspace/group_sanitized.txt > group_inspect_workspace/group_names.txt
tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' < group_inspect_workspace/group_names.txt | sed '/^$/d' > group_inspect_workspace/group_names_normalized.txt
sort group_inspect_workspace/group_names_normalized.txt | uniq -d > group_inspect_workspace/dup_names.txt || true
: > group_inspect_workspace/group_conflicts.log
if [ -s group_inspect_workspace/dup_names.txt ]; then
  while IFS= read -r name; do
    printf 'CONFLICT: %s\n' "$name" >> group_inspect_workspace/group_conflicts.log
    awk -F: -v n="$name" 'tolower($1)==n{print}' group_inspect_workspace/group_sanitized.txt >> group_inspect_workspace/group_conflicts.log
    printf '\n' >> group_inspect_workspace/group_conflicts.log
  done < group_inspect_workspace/dup_names.txt
fi
awk -F: '{n=tolower($1); if(!seen[n]) {print $1; seen[n]=1}}' group_inspect_workspace/group_sanitized.txt > group_inspect_workspace/groups_verified.txt
verified_path="$(pwd)/group_inspect_workspace/groups_verified.txt"
count=$(wc -l < group_inspect_workspace/groups_verified.txt)
printf 'VERIFIED_PATH:%s\nCOUNT:%s\n' "$verified_path" "$count"
"}
